build_vqmodel: build a VQModel with custom num_vq_embeddings and block_out_channels for vector quantized image reconstruction
encode_with_vqmodel: encode an input tensor through the VQModel encoder and quant_conv to get latent representations
decode_with_vqmodel: decode a latent tensor through the VQModel quantizer and decoder to reconstruct the output sample
run_vqmodel_forward: run the VQModel forward pass to encode and decode a sample in one call
review_vqencoderoutput: review the VQEncoderOutput dataclass that holds encoded latent tensors from the VQModel
